title: Fettuccine Alfredo
description: A classic Italian pasta dish made with a rich and creamy sauce. This recipe is quick, easy, and sure to become a favorite.
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil. Cook the fettuccine according to package instructions until al dente.
In a large saucepan, melt the butter over medium heat.
Add the parmesan cheese and stir until melted and smooth.
Pour in the heavy cream and stir until heated through.
Season with nutmeg and salt to taste.
Drain the cooked fettuccine and add to the saucepan.
Toss the fettuccine in the cheese sauce until well coated.
